purpose: Illustrated game art atlases. Cell IDs and crops are defined in src/data/art.js; original PNG files remain in the generation output.

assets.name: scene
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Korean historical cooperative tower-defense game environment art direction concept, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: A beautifully finished high-angle playable-looking Korean mountain fortress village in winter, rendered like a premium stylized 3D animated adventure with hand-painted surfaces. Rebuild the actual architecture, road and props with appealing modeled forms, tactile illustrated texture and coherent lighting, rather than merely adding a dark blue filter.
Camera/composition: elevated orthographic three-quarter game camera looking down at the ground about 55 degrees, NO horizon. Landscape composition. A wide, clearly visible continuous gently S-curving dirt-and-worn-stone path enters at left middle, sweeps through the center and leads into a Korean fortress gate on upper right. Preserve ample readable open ground on both sides for towers; buildings and trees frame the edges without obscuring the path. Keep the entire road uniformly readable; softly graded blue environment without crushed blacks. This is an environment direction illustration, not an exact game layout.
Scene: recognizable Korean traditional curved dark grey tiled roofs, a small hanok pavilion on the upper left, an upper-right fortress stone gate with timber superstructure, a small bronze-bell pavilion farther back, modest stone retaining walls, weathered stairs, pine trees, frosted grass, irregular boulders, a few grouped onggi pottery jars and wooden supply crates near walls, torch brackets and paper lanterns. Set dressing is intentional and sparse. Snow gathers on tile ends, rocks, tree branches and roadside verges; the main path has packed snow, exposed stone, shallow ruts and subtle ice highlights. Warm amber lantern pools at doors and along gate. Deep layered cool blue pines at edges.
Style/medium: rich sculpted animation illustration, subtly exaggerated rounded forms, soft bevels and organic asymmetry, detailed but clean hand-painted wood grain and mossy stone, confident readable silhouettes, soft ambient occlusion, polished cloth/paper/wood/stone material separation, cinematic storybook 3D illustration. High detail close up and good small-scale game readability.
Lighting/mood: diffuse cool slate-blue dusk, soft moonlight, warm gold-orange flame and window light, subtle blue atmospheric depth and faint drifting snow, no heavy black shadows or dense fog. Tactile buildings with light and depth. Palette: slate blue, muted jade, aged timber brown, weathered granite grey, amber flame, restrained cinnabar architectural accents.
Constraints: Korean architecture and landscape identity; no Western medieval cottages or Viking elements, no Japanese torii or pagoda fantasy, no pixel art, no outlined flat cartoon, no photoreal people, no simplistic polygonal geometry, no oversaturated neon. No characters, soldiers, monsters, UI, text, grid, marker circles, decorative frames, logos or watermark. Not a screenshot of an existing game; an original environment concept.

assets.name: heroes
assets.prompt:
Edit target: Image 1, the 4-column 2-row transparent Korean hero atlas. Style reference ONLY: Image 2, stylized animated-adventure man with bow and torch. Image 2 is not an edit target.
Change ONLY the illustration treatment, proportions, and safe margins of Image 1 to match Image 2's expressive sculpted animated-film character rendering. Preserve all EIGHT Korean hero identities, exact 4x2 row-major grid, Korean outfits, colors, weapons, view direction, and alpha transparency. No new subjects.
Critical: Image 1 is too realistic, faces too small and bodies too long. Make all eight VISIBLY stylized 4.2-head-tall animated-adventure characters with heads about 25% larger, broad simple cheek and brow shapes, rounder noses, clear expressive larger eyes, stronger silhouette and chunky but elegant hands and boots. Softer sculpted faces and folded cloth, hand-painted color transitions and beautiful aged-metal surfaces, fully dimensional 3D illustration like reference 2. Not chibi, not doll-like, not photoreal or highly anatomical people.
Composition: eight EQUAL square cells in exact 4-column 2-row transparent atlas, landscape 2:1. ALL heroes face RIGHT at same elevated three-quarter game view. Shrink each complete figure INCLUDING headdresses, hats, plumes, lightning and weapons to fit entirely inside the inner 78% of its own cell. Keep at least 9% alpha padding on all sides of each cell. Feet aligned at 89% cell height. NOTHING may touch the image edge or overlap adjacent cells. Eulji's white feather plume and Gwon's spear MUST be completely inside their cells.
Keep the same row order: top Yi Sun-sin, Sejong, Eulji Mundeok, Gang Gam-chan; bottom Gwon Yul, Gwak Jae-u, An Jung-geun, Dangun. Korean costumes preserved, no Viking/fur outfits copied from style reference. Lighting soft warm upper-left key and cool slate-blue fill, subtle warm rim. Actual transparent background; no ground, labels, grids, frames or shadows.

assets.name: units
assets.prompt:
Edit target: the provided 16-unit transparent game atlas. Preserve all 16 exact identities, costumes, weapons, materials, palette, rendering style, and row-major ordering. Change ONLY layout/spacing and the size of each unit inside its cell.
Critical correction: some units currently run into neighboring cells, creating stray sprite fragments and clipped helmets when the atlas is sliced. RE-LAYOUT the sixteen cutouts into an EXACT MATHEMATICAL 4 x 4 equal-square-cell grid. Use a SQUARE output.
Reduce every complete cutout to ONLY 58% of its cell's width AND height maximum. Leave a wide EMPTY transparent gutter, at least 20% cell width/height on EACH SIDE. Every pixel of every subject must be safely far away from its cell boundaries. This extra large spacing is deliberate and required for a real sprite sheet.
Centers are exactly at normalized canvas coordinates:
row1 y=.125: x=.125,.375,.625,.875;
row2 y=.375: x=.125,.375,.625,.875;
row3 y=.625: x=.125,.375,.625,.875;
row4 y=.875: x=.125,.375,.625,.875.
Each whole figure, hat, crest, blade, spear, drumstick, horse tail and hoof, ram tip and turtle-ship oar MUST fit inside its own small central area. Keep full characters visible, with all weapons. Do not zoom in. Do not enlarge to fill the image.
Exact existing row-major identities unchanged: row1 ashigaru, musketeer, scout, samurai; row2 shinobi, onmyoji, cavalry with horse, drummer; row3 heavy armored infantry, battering ram, Korean militia, Korean guard; row4 Korean elite guard, Korean warrior monk, Korean mounted courier, Korean turtle ship.
All continue facing screen RIGHT. Same dimensional hand-painted animated-adventure style. The image should visibly have LARGE EMPTY SPACE separating all sprites both horizontally and vertically, much more than the input.
TRUE alpha transparent background. Absolutely no scene, floor, shadows, labels, grid lines, numbers or frames. No pixels shared by cells, no stray ornaments, no overlapping silhouettes, no cropped body parts.

assets.name: bosses
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE game sprite atlas, twelve distinct full-body Japanese enemy commanders, precise 4 columns x 3 rows, aspect 4:3, transparent background. Consistent elevated right-facing three-quarter game camera.
Style: premium stylized 3D animated-adventure illustration, strongly sculpted broad faces and expressive eyes, 4.2-head heroic body proportions, large hands and boots, hand-painted layered armor, dimensional textured cloth and worn brass, soft cool blue fill and warm upper-left key. Beautiful modeled shading, no thick black outlines, no photoreal faces. Twelve visually distinct readable silhouettes sharing one art style.
Grid and padding are essential: Divide canvas into 12 identical cells. Each COMPLETE commander including weapon and helmet fits only within the inner 65% of its own cell. At least 17% EMPTY TRANSPARENT gutters on EVERY side. Align feet near 82% of cell height, center each unit at 50% of cell width. NO cell touching, cropping or overlapping. Use short upright weapons, no wide sweeping poses. No backgrounds or floor shadows.
Exact row-major order:
ROW1: 1 Konishi, charcoal/navy samurai armor with white cloth shoulder sash and restrained cross medallion, small gold V helmet crest, commanding folded fan. 2 Kato, formidable black-and-grey samurai with an unusually tall narrow pointed helmet, short upright spear. 3 Wakizaka, ocean-blue and brass samurai armor and broad GOLD crescent helmet crest, short sword. 4 Ukita, plum-purple and brass ornate samurai armor with red neck scarf, gold circular crest and command baton.
ROW2: 5 Ishida, ivory-and-ink samurai armor, dramatic long white mane-like helmet ornament kept inside cell, war fan and scroll. 6 So Yoshitoshi, desaturated green samurai armor, small horizontal gold crest, short sword. 7 Kuroda, black armor and dark crimson trim, broad black folded helmet crest, matchlock pistol held down. 8 Todo, steel-blue layered samurai armor, tall slender double-pronged helmet ornament, small wooden round shield.
ROW3: 9 Kuki, bulky dark navy and dark bronze armor, heavy rounded iron helmet, short naval saber. 10 Kurushima, dark teal and crimson samurai armor, fierce moustache, small gold crescent crest, command baton. 11 Shimazu, massive burgundy and charcoal samurai armor, two compact swept horns on helmet, grey beard, thick short sword. 12 Hideyoshi, intimidating older commander in RICH GOLD layered armor and lavish burgundy brocade cape, golden sunburst helmet crest compact enough to fit the cell, golden gourd ornament at belt, command fan. He is more richly dressed but the same height as other cells.
Constraints: EXACTLY 12 cutouts in exact 4x3 grid with large empty transparent gutters. No extra soldiers, no horses, no labels, no names, no drawn grid, no panels, no decorative frames, no text, no logos or watermark. Whole weapons and boots visible. TRUE transparent alpha.

assets.name: buildings
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production game building sprite texture atlas, exactly TWELVE isolated miniature Korean heritage buildings in precise 4 columns x 3 rows, landscape 4:3, transparent alpha background, prefer 2048 x 1536.
Primary request: Korean tower-defense buildings rendered as premium stylized sculpted 3D animated-adventure illustrations, rich hand-painted tactile aged wood, curved charcoal-blue roof tiles, granite blockwork, moss in seams, muted red and jade dancheong under eaves, warm amber window and lantern light. Full dimensional form, appealing organically irregular edges, realistic material richness with clearly stylized storybook modeling. All use SAME elevated 55-degree three-quarter orthographic game camera, no horizon.
Critical exact row-major grid:
ROW1:
1 Sungnyemun: compact Korean TWO-tier tiled-roof ceremonial gate on a stone arched base, muted red pillars.
2 Hwaseong: compact rounded granite fortress bastion with a small wooden guard pavilion and a single short bronze cannon pointing right.
3 Bosingak: open-sided Korean bell pavilion with ONE tiled roof and a large visible bronze bell between red pillars.
4 Cheomseongdae: recognizable curved/bottle-shaped ancient Korean stacked grey stone observatory with a square stone crown and small rectangular window, faint blue star-glow in opening.
ROW2:
5 Haeinsa: low wide Korean temple sutra repository building with aged timber slat doors and subdued jade-red dancheong, warm golden glow at doorway.
6 Seokguram: compact rounded grass-covered stone grotto, granite arched entrance revealing a small softly lit seated Buddha silhouette.
7 Gyeongbokgung: ornate Korean royal throne hall with two curved dark-tile roof tiers, red-and-jade columns, wide granite platform and front stairs.
8 Namhansanseong: compact granite fortress barracks with crenellations, small tiled-roof timber lookout and two modest blue-and-red pennants.
ROW3:
9 Seokbinggo: low grassy earthen mound over a granite arched ice-store entrance, cool icy-blue light and a few small frost crystals near the opening. Recognizable traditional stone ice store, not a fantasy ice castle.
10 Bulguksa: elegant Korean temple hall on a broad granite stair platform with two small stone pagodas flanking its entrance, subtle warm lanterns.
11 Main fortress gate: a sturdy Korean stone gate and short wall sections, arched timber door facing lower-left/front, one dark-tiled wooden gatehouse with amber lanterns and a small deep red banner.
12 Village palace hall: a modest Korean hanok hall with dark curved tile roof, exposed brown timber frame, glowing paper windows and stone front steps.
Composition: each COMPLETE building has one compact footprint, stands centered in its own EQUAL SQUARE cell, fits inside inner 75% of cell width and height, at least 12% EMPTY TRANSPARENT padding on all sides, no cells overlap. Base contact aligned near 86% cell height. Building 4 naturally slender. Each separate entire object; do not connect buildings or ground between cells.
TRUE transparent background. No characters, UI, text, signs with letters, labels, cell numbers, grid lines, borders, logos, watermark, background landscapes, ground planes or cast floor shadows. No Japanese torii, no Western castles, no simplistic flat cartoon shapes or plastic toy surfaces. Korean heritage-inspired game interpretations.

assets.name: props
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent environment-prop sprite atlas for an elevated Korean tower-defense game. Exact 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 equal SQUARE cells, aspect 4:3, prefer 2048x1536.
Primary request: premium stylized animated-adventure environment objects with modeled rounded organic forms, tactile hand-painted bark, pine needles, mossy granite, layered Korean tile roofs and aged timber. Same elevated orthographic three-quarter camera at about 55 degrees downward for every asset; soft cool slate-blue ambient fill and warm upper-left light. Crisp high quality and good game-scale readability. The illustrated cinematic 3D style of a winter forest adventure, without photorealism or flat outlines.
Exact row-major layout:
ROW 1:
1 A beautiful irregular Korean pine tree with a twisted brown trunk and dense layered deep jade-green needle clusters, full trunk base visible, no snow.
2 Same type Korean pine tree covered by natural blue-white snow on layered branches, full trunk and crown.
3 A richly colored autumn Korean maple tree, burnt copper orange and gold irregular leaves, visible trunk.
4 A compact cluster of six slim Korean bamboo stems with fine deep jade leaves, visible bases, airy silhouette.
ROW 2:
5 A low cluster of three worn moss-covered grey granite boulders, irregular softened edges, subtle cracks.
6 A low cluster of cold blue-grey granite boulders capped with blue-white snow and a little frost.
7 A small traditional Korean hanok dwelling, charcoal-blue curved tile roof, warm glowing paper windows, dark wood grain, stone threshold and an attached amber lantern. Entire house isolated.
8 A small Korean rural thatched-roof dwelling, brown timber frame, textured straw roof and clay plaster, warm light at one paper window.
ROW 3:
9 A compact grouped supply prop of two Korean onggi brown earthenware jars and two small aged wooden crates tied with rope. All four objects form ONE cohesive small cluster.
10 A pair of Korean carved wooden jangseung village guardian posts, expressive rough carved faces, weathered brown timber, no written characters.
11 An irregular moss-covered granite outcrop/cliff, layered stone and a few small tufts of grass, compact readable rocky silhouette.
12 A short wooden pointed-stake palisade wall segment with cross-beams, worn irregular timber and rope ties, viewed at same camera angle.
Composition: each asset fits entirely inside the central 70% of its own cell. At least 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT padding on ALL sides. Center base at 50% cell width and 84% cell height. Every tree crown, roof eave, bamboo leaf, wall tip and stone must stay within its own cell. Exact uniform 4x3 grid, no touching or overlapping between cells.
TRUE alpha transparency. No ground islands or patches under props, no cast floor shadows, no background scenery, no people, no UI, no grid lines, no frames, no labels, no text, no watermark.

assets.name: terrain
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE terrain material texture atlas, EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows of eight perfectly equal SQUARE texture swatches. Landscape 2:1 canvas, prefer 2048x1024. OPAQUE textures fill every cell edge-to-edge with no gutters, borders or labels.
Primary request: eight seamless-looking top-down terrain material paintings for a premium stylized 3D animated-adventure Korean tower-defense game. Tactile softly modeled hand-painted surfaces. These are FLAT GROUND TEXTURES, not 3D objects, not miniature islands, not landscape scenes. Top-down orthographic view exactly perpendicular to surface, no perspective or horizon.
Exact row-major material order:
TOP ROW:
1 Spring woodland ground: subtle small soft jade moss patches mixed with packed blue-grey soil, tiny grass tufts, cool neutral green, organic mottling, readable low contrast.
2 Summer woodland ground: deeper muted jade moss and sparse short green grass over damp grey-brown soil, small subdued stones.
3 Autumn woodland ground: warm grey-brown earth with sparse tiny copper and ochre fallen leaf fragments, mostly muted earth surface, low contrast.
4 Winter ground: fine softly undulating blue-white packed snow with very subtle shallow frozen-soil blemishes and tiny blue-grey grit. Bright enough to read but cool slate-blue shadow tint.
BOTTOM ROW:
5 Worn dirt-and-stone road: gently uneven packed grey-brown soil with embedded SMALL flat worn sandstone and grey cobbles in irregular loose patterns, shallow ruts and tiny grit. No large rectangular paving blocks, no direction.
6 Winter road: blue-grey compacted snow with sparse exposed small worn grey stone and tiny footprints and icy highlights, low contrast even surface, no straight road edges.
7 Korean courtyard paving: small irregular flat weathered grey granite slabs with soft seams and muted sparse moss, gently rounded worn edges, no ornate patterns.
8 Dark cool river water: deep muted teal-blue surface with fine soft gently waving ripples and subtle moon-blue glints, no objects, foam bands, shore or reflections of buildings.
Lighting: diffuse soft overhead light, cool neutral palette with preserved midtones. Hand-painted premium animated-feature material quality, dimensional gentle microshadow and organic variation. Keep all swatches equally lit with no directional gradients or vignettes so a cropped swatch can tile.
Constraints: EXACT 4x2 equal seamless material cells; textures have uniform scale (stones are small, no boulder closeups); no plants taller than short grass, no big leaves, no trees, no buildings, no props, no people, no aerial photography, no text, no labels, no frames, no grid lines, no watermark. Each of eight regions occupies exactly one quarter width and one half height.
